canonical_project: SIN + ST Digital private cloud at Lomé Data Centre
notes: Service-level record, not a new physical datacenter: SIN and ST Digital signed a strategic partnership to launch private cloud services deployed at the existing Lomé Data Centre facility. ST Digital markets a redundant data centre (99.99% availability, multi-operator fibre access across West Africa) hosted at LDC. Per TG methodology this is separated from the LDC facility record.
